nodes.label: S5 — Lessons List and Detail (research doc)
D44 — item ids come from GET /api/v2/lessons/:id/items, not a fatter lesson payload
nodes.rationale: LessonDetail carries no item ids at all, so the editing screen cannot remove an item without a new route.

nodes.label: D45 — POST /api/v2/sync/flush calls new lib/sync-flush.ts, not flushOutbox
nodes.rationale: flushOutbox derives the owner from the cookie session; called from a Bearer route it silently returns applied: [] for every request.

nodes.label: D46 — batch validated at the edge via parseOutboxRecords in shared sync-ops
nodes.rationale: applyOp's switch has no default, so an unrecognized op kind is reported as applied — a lie to our own client over the Server Action, attacker-triggerable over a public Bearer route.

nodes.label: D47 — applied stays 'stop retrying'; FlushResult does not grow
nodes.rationale: Per-op outcomes would introduce a second vocabulary of success beside 'may I drop this record', and everything they'd carry is already derivable from the client's refetch.

nodes.label: D48 — the optimistic view is built from the op, not a mirror
nodes.rationale: The Dexie mirror's guarantee was never consistency, it was 'build the view from the op'; React state can do that without durability.

nodes.label: D49 — client ids come from expo-crypto, added explicitly
nodes.rationale: The ambient crypto.randomUUID shim installed by LiveKit's registerGlobals() is Math.random()-backed and ambient; a collision under ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING silently makes a lesson not exist.

nodes.label: D50 — lessons list becomes app/index.tsx (home)
nodes.rationale: There is no separate landing screen to justify on a phone.

nodes.label: D51 — words editing is its own screen: lessons/[id]/words
nodes.rationale: items_list is baked into dynamicVariables at connect, so inline editing under a live transcript would advertise an immediacy that doesn't exist.

nodes.label: D52 — delete confirmation is Alert.alert, not a ported ConfirmDialog
nodes.rationale: RN's Alert gives focus/dismissal/VoiceOver/destructive styling for free; ConfirmDialog's 73 lines exist only to give the browser what iOS already has natively.

nodes.label: D53 — no pagination on GET /api/v2/lessons
nodes.rationale: List is bounded by how many lessons one person makes by hand; a cap would need a 'showing N of M' affordance for a limit nobody has reached.

nodes.label: D54 — sendContextualUpdate stays unmeasured at S5, deliberately
nodes.rationale: S5 doesn't touch the resume path; building one just to close the gap would add a second risk to a stage measuring neither.
